rules.title: Rules
rules.place: Placing: Taking turns, each side places its 9 stones on free points.
rules.move: Moving: Then a stone moves along a line to a free neighbouring point.
rules.mill: Mill: Three of your stones in one line. You may then take an opponent's stone, but none from a closed mill while other stones are free.
rules.fly: Flying: With only 3 stones left, you may jump to any free point.
rules.end: End: You lose with only 2 stones left or when you cannot move. After 50 moves per side without a mill the game is a draw.
